description: Staubbach Falls drops as a tall, thin veil from the lip of the western cliff above Lauterbrunnen. Wooden chalets and the church spire sit at the base of the wall, with late-September meadows still green. The fall is the cliff waterfall, not a wide river cataract. The Open-Meteo model for the valley is heavily clouded, and the light is soft.
